kind: Native Linux amd64 App, installed indexed worker and native SDK observer. All provider, tracker and qB endpoints owned loopback with real local filesystem operations.

mapping.behavior: The active source-owned RSS acquisition seals title-listed scope, source priority and exact material. Whole quality selection retains source subset/superset behavior. File-dependent inspection treats a valid magnet as a skipped candidate.
The active RSS root commits success before the dependent completion job may retire the unchanged subscription, using actual downloader acceptance.

observations: A verified Lark refresh consulted a no-episode pack, skipped its magnet at the file-inspection branch, and submitted one whole unpaused Add of the exact title-proven S01E02 URI.
The SDK observer received the magnet as a string. Only E02 reached priority 100; E01 stayed unchanged. Before completion the old managed E02 file and its original download source remained.
After qB reported complete files, the native App validated the scope and performed an actual hardlink replacement. The old and new download sources remained available.
An active full-quality subscription requested E02. Its fixed-source complete-coverage rule authorized one exact whole E01–E02 magnet, with no file selection.

The exact RSS root succeeded before its linked preparation and completion jobs. A source-shaped history and completion receipt refer to the actual accepted intent, and the subscription was retired before the daemon exposed completed files.
The native App later checked both completed files and created real hardlinks. E01 was added as a declared extra; only the old managed E02 slot was replaced. The old download source was preserved.

superseded_attempt.cause: The first native matcher rejected a title containing a known episode outside the subscription start range before full-coverage quality selection. Corrected RSS filtering separates release identity from requested episode scope. The already passing episode scenario was not rerun.

adaptations_and_open: The target independently confirms actual on-disk files before applying quality replacement. Subscription progress and completion follow the real Add receipt and source priority even when files are not yet complete.
Recovery for already queued quality completion from a pre-fix experimental host was not separately exercised. The new active RSS preparation is enqueued atomically from its exact successful root.
